headline: The panel is quieter: one switch at the top, one number that answers, and the filters behind one button.
notes: Active cut or Project, as one switch. Active cut answers about the sequence you have open, and other sequences are one line away
The answer leads: uses in this cut, or the gigabytes not used, in large type at the top
The Project view is a checklist now: not used, imported more than once, offline, empty bins. Press a line to see it
Used and not used are 2 numbers you press, so you can see what is in the cut against what is not
Every filter lives behind the Filters button, which counts what is on
Select a bin and Trace+ lists what in it is not in your cut yet
Build a sequence of the unused parts of a clip, back to back, to scrub through what you never touched
Files inside a multicam count as used, cameras and synced audio, so Move to _UNUSED leaves them alone
Next and previous moved up beside the number they step through
Compare cuts is off for now while the panel is simplified
